{{Quote|There are times when one realizes how convoluted the galactic underworld is. One such occasion was researching the Tonnika Sisters on Mos Eisley.|Alliance historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="TMTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Brea Tonnika''' was a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and identical twin of [[Senni Tonnika/Legends|Senni Tonnika]]. The two were known as the '''[[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Tonnika sisters]]''' and became infamous [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]] under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], they earned additional fame for being in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] first met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], but in fact, the "Tonnika sisters" in the Cantina were the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] warriors [[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Karoly D'ulin]], masquerading as Brea and Senni in the course of a mission.

==Biography==
===Early years===
[[File:Brea_Tonnika_mugshot.png|thumb|left|200px|A mugshot of Brea Tonnika viewed in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
Brea Tonnik and her sister [[Senni Tonnika/Legends|Senni]] grew up on the colony of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]]. After being abandoned by their parents in early childhood, the sisters were raised by the colonists in safety and with affection, but they were led astray through a desire for money which their homeworld could not offer. When a young scout pilot arrived on Kiffex to take on provisions, the teenage twins persuaded him to take them offworld with them, claiming falsely that they had been maltreated by the colonists.<ref name="GG1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="EGC" />

As early as the Clone Wars, Brea was already a criminal wanted for murder. At the time she had been spotted on Coruscant.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

===Career as con-artists===
Over the following years, the Tonnika sisters acquired a reputation among [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] leading [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]], running several notorious scams against high-society targets, ranging from [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] to members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] new elite.<ref name="GG1" /> During this time, they were pursued by the Kiffex security officer [[Vul Tazaene]], who was in love with one of the twins but was not sure which one.<ref name="CCG Vul Tazaene">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Vul Tazaene}}</ref>

On one occassion, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]&mdash;who had come to know the sisters through his dealings with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]&mdash;persuaded them to help him play a trick on the smooth-talking [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]]. Solo arranged for Calrissian to meet "Bresenni" in [[The High Stakes Casino]] on the planet [[Balfron/Legends|Balfron]], and although Calrissian thought that his new "girlfriend" suffered from severe personality shifts as the sisters swapped around in the role, he genuinely believed that he was growing close to her when Brea and Senni revealed the deception. As he watched a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-message from Han, Calrissian was at first dejected and angry, but quickly softened, although he vowed to get even with Solo for the stunt.<ref name="Double Vision">{{WEGCite|story=Double Vision|book=Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope|reprint=1}}</ref>

On another occasion, the Tonnika sisters conned [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Argon (Grand Moff)|Argon]] out of twenty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], just before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to attend a party thrown by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] at his palace on the edge of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="GG1" /> 

Around this time, the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] warriors [[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Karoly D'ulin]] began impersonating the Tonnika sisters, with D'ukal assuming the identity of Brea Tonnika. This led to them being arrested by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Parq]] on behalf of Grand Moff Argon, believing them to be the real twins.<ref name="Hammertong">{{StoryCite|story=Hammertong: The Tale of the "Tonnika Sisters"|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}} </ref>

The Tonnika sisters themselves eluded capture, despite the efforts of Argon's agents, and continued to operate as con artists. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Tonnika sisters became affiliated with [[Lando's Commandos]].<ref name="VSV">{{SW|url=news/viva-space-vegas-the-history-of-the-marvelous-wheel-part-2|series=Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> The true identities of the Mistryl "Tonnika sisters" were not disclosed in Winward's report to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], and would go unrevealed to Rebel/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] personnel until D'ukal petitioned [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to join the New Republic during the [[Caamas Document]] crisis.<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tonnika1.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Karoly D'ulin]] and [[Shada D'ukal]] disguised as the Tonnika sisters.]]
In [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], two tall girls appear together in the Cantina scene, wearing matching catsuits, and with braided hair piled high on their heads. Played by real-life friends [[Christine Hewett]] and [[Angela Staines]], they were known by the simple production nickname "Space Girls"<ref name="CantinaRollCall">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>

[[Christine Hewett]] has since been identified as portraying [[Shada D'ukal]], disguised as Brea Tonnika<ref name="StarWars.com Message Boards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM|quote=Hewett was Brea... I mean Shada. Check out the Q&A of Insider #95 for the full answer. }}</ref> with [[Angela Staines]] portraying [[Karoly D'ulin]], disguised as [[Senni Tonnika/Legends|Senni Tonnika]] in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="StarWars.com Message Boards" />

It is sometimes thought by fans that the girl who kisses Han in the ANH rough-cut is one of the Tonnika sisters. In fact, this "Cantina Girl" is a different character known only as [[Jenny/Legends|Jenny]], played by actress [[Jenny Cresswell]].

In ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'', these characters were identified as the interplanetary con-artistes Brea and Senni Tonnika, but the article insisted that the sisters were identical twins, both 1.6 meters tall, while the characters seen on screen were visibly different in height and appearance. Hence, [[Timothy Zahn]]'s short story ''[[Hammertong: The Tale of the "Tonnika Sisters"]]'' established a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] that identified the girls in the Mos Eisley Cantina as [[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Karoly D'ulin]], disguised as the Tonnika sisters.

This retcon was possible due to the original ''Galaxy Guide'' material being presented from an [[in-universe]] perspective, as the work of [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]. Subsequently, however, the ''Galaxy Guide'' version of events has been further undermined by the depiction of [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' comics, particularly in the [[Star Wars: Darkness|''Darkness'']] storyline, which is largely set on the prison-world.
